Body and comments describe preventing a modal from retargeting when the active document changes, not merely reading the live document. Selection clearing does not prove that contract. The source concerns failed worker launch and escaped native panics leaving job state active; JS exception/timeout tests alone do not verify those boundaries. Inspect proposed export/Action-Wizard-only PR 4043 and test actual provider failure/reset/retry outcomes.
